# model.createLogicSwitch

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 26.1.0</span></div>

Create a logic switch.

```lua
model.createLogicSwitch()
```

## Parameters

None.

## Returns

the new logic switch

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
local ls = model.createLogicSwitch()
ls:name("My Logic Switch")
ls:function(LS_FN_AND)
print(ls:value())
```
